name: fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule
description: Gated delta-rule recurrence. q and k are [B,T,H,K], v is [B,T,HV,V], and each value head uses query/key head hv // (HV // H). For each step, decay the FP32 state by exp(g), compute the prediction from the decayed state and k, add the outer product of beta*(v-prediction) and k, then project the updated state with q*scale. The kernel accepts beta per value head or per value channel; the Torch reference exercises scalar beta per head. Optionally L2-normalize q and k. Return a new [B,T,HV,V] tensor in v.dtype and a new FP32 [B,HV,V,K] final state when requested, or None in the second position otherwise. initial_state may be None and is read-only.
